name: Basal amygdala fear neuron
morphology_summary: Spiny glutamatergic principal neuron in BA/BLA; projects to medial prefrontal cortex; does not receive reciprocal mPFC input (distinguishing it from extinction neurons)
ephys_summary: Not described in supplied references; defined primarily by activity during conditioned stimulus presentation rather than intrinsic electrophysiological profile
subtypes_noted: Functionally distinct from extinction neurons (non-overlapping populations; Herry et al., 2008 via Cardenas et al., 2019); molecular anchoring weak — no dedicated transcriptomic marker panel identified in supplied references

name: Basal amygdala extinction neuron (Fear-Off neuron)
morphology_summary: Spiny glutamatergic principal neuron in BA/BLA; projects to medial prefrontal cortex and receives reciprocal mPFC input, unlike fear neurons
ephys_summary: Not described in supplied references; defined primarily by activity during repeated unreinforced conditioned stimulus presentations (extinction) rather than intrinsic electrophysiology
subtypes_noted: Ntsr2-expressing subpopulation validated as putative Fear-Off class (McCullough et al., 2016); Dkk3, Rspo2, Wnt7a co-enriched in Thy1-labeled Fear-Off neurons by RNA-seq

name: BLA NPY neurogliaform interneuron
morphology_summary: Neurogliaform-like morphology; local GABAergic interneuron; constitutes approximately 14-15% of GABAergic cells in LA/BA (Vereczki et al., 2021)
subtypes_noted: Distinguished from PV basket cells, CCK basket cells, SST dendrite-targeting cells, and VIP/CR interneuron-selective interneurons in the quantitative LA/BA GABAergic census (Vereczki et al., 2021); no direct patch-seq or scRNA-seq marker panel in supplied references

name: BLA calbindin-positive dendrite-targeting interneuron
morphology_summary: Local GABAergic interneuron with dendrite-focused innervation pattern; immunoreactive for calbindin (CB/CALB1); distinct from PV-expressing basket or axo-axonic cells
subtypes_noted: Recruited during fear extinction upon orexin-1 receptor blockade (Flores et al., 2017); activity distinct from parvalbumin-positive interneurons in same setting; SST-expressing dendrite-targeting cells (~10-16% of LA/BA GABAergic neurons) noted separately in Vereczki et al., 2021 — relationship to calbindin class not resolved in supplied references

name: Central amygdala large aspiny neuron
morphology_summary: Large aspiny neuron; morphologically classified striatum-like GABAergic projection neuron in CeA; aspiny (lacking dendritic spines) distinguishes it from glutamatergic principal cells of the BLA
subtypes_noted: Classical morphological distinction from small aspiny neurons; modern scRNA-seq (Hochgerner et al., 2023 — 130 neuronal types) provides framework for eventual molecular mapping, but one-to-one transcriptomic marker set not recovered from supplied references

name: Central amygdala small aspiny neuron
morphology_summary: Small aspiny neuron; morphologically classified striatum-like GABAergic projection neuron in CeA; size distinguishes it from large aspiny class
subtypes_noted: Classical morphological distinction from large aspiny neurons; modern scRNA-seq (Hochgerner et al., 2023) provides atlas framework but one-to-one transcriptomic marker set not recovered from supplied references

name: Paralaminar nucleus immature excitatory neuron
morphology_summary: Immature excitatory neuron with protracted developmental timeline; persists through childhood and adolescence; born from local progenitors that disappear rapidly in infancy
ephys_summary: Not described in supplied references; developmental immaturity implies likely immature electrophysiological properties but not quantified in supplied references
subtypes_noted: Defined by developmental state (immature) rather than mature morphological or molecular class; some born from local progenitors present at birth; progenitors disappear in infancy while neurons persist into adolescence (Page et al., 2022); no scRNA-seq marker panel in supplied references
